top_apps.description_short: Dash across the road, dodge the traffic, grow your multiplier and win!
top_apps.description_excerpt:
Crossroad Fury — one more lane… or cash out before the bumper?

Our fearless chicken is ready to brave the busiest road in town! Tap GO to dash one lane forward — every lane you survive cranks your multiplier higher. But traffic never stops, and one wrong move ends the run. Do you hit CASH OUT and pocket a safe win, or push your luck for one more lane and a massive payout?

It's a wild, fast, nerve-shredding game of nerve and greed — easy to play, impossible to put down.

HOW TO PLAY • Set your bet and pick a difficulty • Press GO to move one lane forward — each lane raises your multiplier • Cash out any time to keep your winnings • Get hit by a car and you lose your bet • Higher difficulty = bigger multipliers, but higher risk!

FOUR DIFFICULTY MODES Easy, Medium, Hard and Hardcore. Crank up the danger for sky-high multipliers — if you've got the nerve.

FORTUNE WHEEL Spin the daily wheel for free coins, gems and mega prizes.

DAILY BONUS Log in every day for a growing reward — 7 days of escalating prizes leading to a big chest!

RANKINGS Climb the global leaderboard, outscore rivals and prove you're the boldest bird on the road.
